subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Pseudo
solution: The correct answer is: **Pseudo.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Pseudo** means pretended and not real (दिखावा करना ; वास्तविक नहीं) ** • Example- ***Her care for the poor is completely **pseudo. *** • Marked option **Genuine** means things are authentic. (चीजें जो प्रामाणिक हैं।) ** • Example-* ****This ring is genuine **gold.*** • It is clear that **Pseudo **and **Genuine** are opposite in meaning. Therefore the correct answer is **option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Flawed** means an imperfection or weakness and especially one that detracts from the whole or hinders. (एक अपूर्णता या कमजोरी और विशेष रूप से एक जो पूरी तरह से अलग हो जाती है या बाधा डालती है।) • **Artificial** means not genuine or natural but made by people. (वास्तविक या प्राकृतिक नहीं बल्कि लोगों द्वारा बनाया गया) • **Corrupt **means doing or involving illegal or dishonest things in exchange for money, etc. (पैसे आदि के बदले में अवैध या बेईमान चीजें करना या शामिल करना।) 2f:T7e2, The segment that contains a grammatical error is **'****fastly above'.**
